evidence: Three routes, all re-run by verify_roelen_2020_rses.R (VERDICT: PASS). (a) ITEM AXIS -- label match, not inference: data/roelen_2020_haiti_battery.py melts RSES_COLS = [f"q_{i}" for i in range(407,417)] by NAME, so the IRW codes ARE the .dta's column names (derivation pattern 1, exempt), and the script re-reads the deposited .dta (10.1371/journal.pone.0243457.s002) and diffs its variable labels against the shipped item_text: 10/10 exact string matches, e.g. q_407 label 'On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.' and q_415 label 'All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.'. This distinguishes every item from every other item. (b) RESP AXIS -- route 9, 40/40 cells: the .dta codes 1=Strongly agree..4=Strongly disagree while the live table runs the OPPOSITE way (pandas.read_stata decodes to strings, then MAP_RSES re-encodes Strongly disagree=1..Strongly agree=4), so this was checked cell by cell: all 10 items x 4 levels match exactly -- q_407 raw code 1 n=80 vs live resp 4 n=80; raw code 3 n=688 vs live resp 2 n=688; raw code 2 n=536 vs live resp 3 n=536; raw code 4 n=77 vs live resp 1 n=77, and the same for the other nine items. (c) ROUTE 7, independent of the .dta -- the paper's Discussion states 94.7% agreed or strongly agreed with RSES item 8; live q_414 at resp 3+4 = 1308/1381 = 94.7%, against 44.6/78.3/79.7/57.3/63.8/73.7/59.4/59.2/82.2% for the other nine items, so the statistic is unique to q_414 and pins that item and the resp direction on its own. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing about the item mapping is left open -- (a) is a per-item label identity, not an ordering inference. It does NOT establish that the shipped ENGLISH is what respondents heard: the administration was oral Haitian Creole and no Creole wording is published (see provenance), so the item_text is a parallel-language substitute whose fidelity to the Creole cannot be checked from any available source. It also does not establish reverse-scoring status by itself; that the table stores raw, unreversed responses is read off the same 40 counts.
